props.title: When will Russia be able to fully access its frozen foreign exchange reserves?
props.shortTitle: When will Russia get back its frozen foreign exchange reserves?
props.details:
Western sanctions imposed on Russia in late February 2022 became the basis for freezing part of the gold and foreign exchange reserves of the Russian Central Bank. In March 2022, Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov said that Western countries had blocked about half of the Bank of Russia's gold and foreign exchange reserves - about $300 billion out of $640 billion. In October 2024, the head of the Russian Central Bank, Elvira Nabiullina, said that the Bank was working to return these funds.

Resolution

The question will resolve whenever the freezed Russian foreign exchange reserves are fully returned to Russian control, based on credible news sources.
